notes: N075_01 — Source statement. The page continues the discussion of an inertia expression, then introduces f_K with an additional standalone K at the next line. It writes a section psi=psi_{f_K} de E_K sur E_{U_K}. That exact order and the isolated K are preserved. It lists conditions a), b), and b prime and explicitly calls them equivalent.

N075_02 — Source statement. The author calls the equivalence of b) and b prime and their implication from a) clear, then says the implication b) to a) requires a demonstration. The text gives a descent reduction to a strictly local T and writes the displayed Gal expression and the inserted E_S=(1). This report records the source assertions without certifying their mathematical validity.

N075_03 — Source revision and lemma opening. The author crosses the genus phrase and adds a raised expression U=X setminus T, X lisse et propre. After the canceled rationnelle and inserted de, the source states f(S) subset U and begins an underlined Lemme about X, relative dimension 1, and the final overwritten S/T trait. The page ends with a comma; the lemma is not completed here.

N075_04 — Source language. The dotted i and single l of qu’ils/qu’il are retained with a tentative final s. Unaccented impliques and clair remain from the ink. The source wording is not adjusted through an identification of the two overwritten base letters.

N075_05 — Physical revision. The small raised word before genre and the final S/T overwrite are included with narrow unresolved readings. The head 37 is autograph; the lower-left 74 is secondary foliation in another hand.

The independent audit confirms the raised prime by x and the upright field separator, broadens the canceled item label, marks the terminal s, comma and two compressed live words, and recovers tentative est beneath the genus cancellation. The original fixed readings and fourteen crop decisions remain in second/. No mathematical check was added.
